import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int k = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] inputLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] l = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            l[i] = Integer.parseInt(inputLine[i]) % k;
        }
        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(l[0]);
            return;
        }
        int[] l1 = Arrays.copyOfRange(l, 0, n / 2);
        int[] l2 = Arrays.copyOfRange(l, n / 2, n);
        Set<Integer> s = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> s1 = new HashSet<>();
        Set<Integer> s2 = new HashSet<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < l1.length; i++) {
            for (int j : s) {
                s2.add((j + l1[i]) % k);
            }
            s.add(l1[i]);
            for (int j : s2) {
                s.add(j);
            }
            s2.clear();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < l2.length; i++) {
            for (int j : s1) {
                s2.add((j + l2[i]) % k);
            }
            s1.add(l2[i]);
            for (int j : s2) {
                s1.add(j);
            }
            s2.clear();
        }
        List<Integer> sList = new ArrayList<>(s);
        List<Integer> s1List = new ArrayList<>(s1);
        Collections.sort(sList);
        Collections.sort(s1List);
        int ans = Math.max(sList.get(sList.size() - 1), s1List.get(s1List.size() - 1));
        for (int i = 0; i < sList.size(); i++) {
            int t = k - 1 - sList.get(i);
            int ind = binarySearchCount(s1List, t);
            int r = s1List.get(ind - 1);
            int rt = s1List.get(s1List.size() - 1);
            int tmax = ans;
            ans = Math.max(Math.max((r + sList.get(i)) % k, (sList.get(i) + rt) % k), tmax);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    private static int binarySearchCount(List<Integer> arr, int key) {
        int left = 0;
        int right = arr.size() - 1;
        int count = 0;
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (arr.get(mid) <= key) {
                count = mid + 1;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
}
